findings.issue: ל plus indefinite tent is rendered by bare «a tienda»; «a» stays inside the preposition’s to/for range but compresses purpose or role.
The object suffix is 3rd masculine plural; «las» is feminine so it agrees with cortinas. Same plural referent, grammatical smoothing.

notes: Both 2ms qal verbs, goat curtains, eleven, repetition, and the definite tabernacle are licensed.
